subject: quantitative_aptitude
question: In a group of N students, the average score on a mathematics assessment was 64. If the top 20% highest scoring students had an average score of 88, and the bottom 25% lowest scoring students had an average score of 40, what was the average score of the remaining 55% of the students?
explanation: Assume a benchmark cohort of 100 students (sum of scores = 100 × 64 = 6,400). Top 20% (20 students) total = 20 × 88 = 1,760. Bottom 25% (25 students) total = 25 × 40 = 1,000. Subtotal of extreme cohorts = 1,760 + 1,000 = 2,760 for 45 students. Total score of remaining 55% (55 students) = 6,400 - 2,760 = 3,640. Average score of remaining students = 3,640 / 55 = 66.1818... ≈ 66.2.
